diff --git a/components/auth/login-form.tsx b/components/auth/login-form.tsx
index 9dfb78b..9a15d13 100644
--- a/components/auth/login-form.tsx

   const callbackUrl = searchParams.get('callbackUrl') || pathname;
 
   // Helper function to get valid auth message key

+    message: string | undefined
+  ):
     | 'error.invalidField'
     | 'error.incorrectPassword'
     | 'error.invalidCode'
@@ -222,7 +224,11 @@ const LoginForm = () => {
                   />
                 )}
               />
-              <TrackedLink href="/auth/reset" className="text-xs underline">

+                href="/auth/reset"
+                className="text-xs underline"

             </>
